title: Programming Fundamentals
description: Evaluate your grasp of object-oriented concepts, loops, debugging, variable scope, and clean coding.
seoTitle: Programming Fundamentals Quiz – OOP & Logic Test | AI Quiz Arena
seoDescription: Sharpen your coding skills with 10 questions on OOP principles, variable types, loops, and control flow.

questions.question: Which of the following is NOT one of the four foundational pillars of Object-Oriented Programming (OOP)?
questions.explanation: The four core pillars of OOP are Encapsulation, Abstraction, Inheritance, and Polymorphism. Compilation is a translation process.

questions.question: In JavaScript and TypeScript, which keyword declares a block-scoped variable that cannot be reassigned?
questions.explanation: 'const' declares a block-scoped identifier that cannot be reassigned after its initial declaration.

questions.question: What is the standard name for an error where a program continues running a loop indefinitely?
questions.explanation: An infinite loop occurs when the loop's termination condition is never reached or always evaluates to true.

questions.question: Which programming language is predominantly used to add interactive behavior to client-side web applications?
questions.explanation: JavaScript is the primary programming language of the World Wide Web, supported by all major web browsers natively.

questions.question: What does the acronym 'DRY' stand for in software engineering best practices?
questions.explanation: DRY stands for 'Don't Repeat Yourself', emphasizing that every piece of knowledge or logic must have a single authoritative representation.

questions.question: What is the purpose of a 'try...catch' block in modern programming languages?
questions.explanation: 'try...catch' allows developers to test code for errors during execution and intercept exceptions without crashing the program.

questions.question: What data format uses curly braces for objects, square brackets for arrays, and is based on a JavaScript subset?
questions.explanation: JSON (JavaScript Object Notation) is a lightweight, human-readable data interchange format ubiquitous in web APIs.

questions.question: Which version control command creates a new working branch in Git and switches to it in one step?
questions.explanation: 'git checkout -b <branch>' (or modern 'git switch -c <branch>') creates a new branch and immediately checks it out.

questions.question: What is the return value of 15 % 4 in modular arithmetic?
questions.explanation: 15 divided by 4 equals 3 with a remainder of 3 (4 * 3 = 12; 15 - 12 = 3).

questions.question: What programming paradigm treats computation as the evaluation of mathematical functions without mutating state?
questions.explanation: Functional programming focuses on pure functions, immutability, and avoiding shared state or side effects.
